content.text: You’ve tried to sell your ebook. PayPal rejected your country. Stripe locked you out. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle—all inaccessible. The problem isn’t your product. It’s the architecture. Centralized [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-what-actually-how|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms exclude entire regions based on geopolitical risk, not your merit. They rent you access to their systems, then revoke it without notice. Sovereign commerce infrastructure solves this permanently. It’s not a workaround—it’s base-layer ownership. Your store runs on code you control, hosted on decentralized networks, processing payments directly on-chain. No platform can shut you down. No country restrictions apply. This is the real [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-presets-without-stripe-what-nobody-tells-you-2|Selling Presets]]-fonts-online-without|difference]] between renting access and owning infrastructure.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Centralized platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy promise simplicity but deliver dependency. They host your product, process payments, and handle delivery—until they don’t. They operate as middlemen, extracting fees and dictating terms. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, like the Edge Commerce Stack, flips this model. You own the hosting (Cloudflare Pages), the backend logic (Cloudflare Workers), the order storage (Supabase), and the file delivery (Cloudflare R2). Payments are processed on-chain via NOWPayments, with 0.5% fees and no KYC. The stack is deployed in 48 hours, configured for your products, and handed over entirely to you. No subscriptions. No access revocation. Full ownership from day one. This isn’t a tool—it’s a permanent shift in control.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Centralized platforms exclude countries based on financial risk, regulatory pressure, or geopolitical strategy. Nigeria, Ghana, Zimbabwe—entire markets are locked out of Stripe, PayPal, and their alternatives. These platforms operate under the laws of their host countries, which often prioritize Western markets. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this entirely. It’s built on decentralized networks that don’t recognize borders. Cloudflare Pages hosts your store globally. Supabase stores orders without jurisdiction. NOWPayments processes crypto payments from any country, on any network. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for regions where traditional platforms fail. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative. You’re not begging for access. You’re building on infrastructure that can’t exclude you.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Centralized platforms charge 5-10% per transaction, plus hidden fees for currency conversion, chargebacks, and withdrawals. Payments take days to settle, and accounts can be frozen without warning. Sovereign commerce infrastructure cuts out the middlemen. NOWPayments charges 0.5% for on-chain crypto payments, with no additional fees. Transactions confirm in minutes, not days. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys for a one-time fee of $197, with no recurring costs. You pay for hosting and storage only if you scale beyond free tiers. The real cost comparison is clear: centralized platforms extract rent indefinitely. Sovereign infrastructure is a fixed investment in ownership.
Centralized platforms exclude you based on geography. Sovereign infrastructure doesn’t recognize borders.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Centralized platforms own your data, your customer relationships, and your ability to operate. They automate delivery—until they flag your account or shut it down. Sovereign commerce infrastructure automates everything while handing you the keys. The Edge Commerce Stack includes end-to-end testing, SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration, and instant file delivery via Cloudflare R2. Once deployed, the system runs without COREMERCH’s involvement. You control the code, the data, and the customer experience. Updates are pushed via GitHub. Orders are stored in your Supabase database. Payments trigger automatic delivery via webhooks. This isn’t automation as a feature—it’s automation as a right. You’re not renting it. You own it.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a restricted country and need to sell now, centralized platforms are not an option—they’ve already excluded you. Workarounds like VPNs or proxy accounts are temporary and risky. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack is built for creators who value ownership over convenience, control over access. It’s a one-time investment in infrastructure that can’t be taken away. If you’re selling digital products and want to bypass financial exclusion, this is your architecture. It’s not the easiest path—but it’s the only one that guarantees you can’t be locked out. Choose based on what you’re building: a temporary store or a sovereign business.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Edge Commerce Stack for full ownership, or Sovereign Starter Stack for basic deployment. 2. Provide product details: title, description, price, and file for each item. 3. Select payment networks: BSC, Solana, or TRON for low transaction fees. 4. Confirm deployment details: GitHub or Cloudflare account access for setup. 5. Review configuration: email setup, webhook integration, and file delivery paths. 6. Approve deployment: COREMERCH deploys your stack within 48 hours. 7. Test the system: end-to-end testing ensures all components work seamlessly. 8. Take ownership: receive full access to code, databases, and hosting.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I’m in Nigeria?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for creators in restricted countries like Nigeria. It bypasses centralized platforms and processes payments on-chain via NOWPayments, with no country restrictions.
What happens after the 30-day support period ends?

After deployment, you own the entire stack. The 30-day support period covers initial setup and troubleshooting. Beyond that, you control updates and maintenance. COREMERCH has no access to your infrastructure.
Can I add more products after deployment?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack includes five products loaded at deployment. You can add more by updating the Supabase database and file delivery paths. The system is fully customizable post-deployment.
What if crypto prices fluctuate?

The Edge Commerce Stack processes payments in stablecoins or cryptocurrencies of your choice. Fluctuations don’t affect the system’s functionality. You can adjust prices or payment networks as needed.
Do I need technical skills to manage the stack?

Basic technical knowledge is helpful but not required. The stack is deployed with full automation and documentation. Updates are pushed via GitHub, and the system is designed for ease of use. COREMERCH provides initial setup and support.
